summary_1line: Garuda devours the elephant and tortoise, terrifying omens alarm the gods as he approaches to seize the amrita, prompting Indra and the deities to prepare defenses.

image_candidates.scene_text: Garuda drops the gigantic tree branch onto a jeweled mountain, shaking its peaks and scattering golden-flowered trees in a storm of petals.
Perched on a mountain summit, the immense Garuda devours the elephant and tortoise before launching back into the sky.
The assembled gods in golden armor surround the amrita with blazing weapons as meteors fall and the sky rains blood with ominous thunder.
